title: Absolute foundations
focus: No songs yet — build the physical skills every song depends on: finding notes, posture, major/minor chord shapes, reading chord symbols.
goals: Learn finger numbering (1-5) for both hands and practice 5-finger scale runs in C
Find every C, and every white-key note, without counting from scratch
Play major triads (block chords) in C, G, and F — clean, no fumbling
Play minor triads in Am, Em, Dm
Practice switching between just 2 chords (e.g. C to G) slowly and smoothly, 10 min/day

title: First pattern + first song
focus: Add the broken-chord pattern, and play your first real song using block chords in the simplest progression family (I-IV-V).
goals: Learn the broken-chords-simple left-hand pattern (Technique Library)
Practice I-IV-V in 2-3 keys until it's automatic
Pick 1-2 Foundation songs tagged I-IV-V and play them with block chords, slow tempo
Start singing the melody yourself while your left hand plays

title: I-V-vi-IV — the most common pop progression (29 songs unlocked)
focus: This one progression appears more than any other in your list. Master it once, unlock a whole cluster of songs.
goals: Drill I-V-vi-IV in C (C-G-Am-F) until your hand finds it without looking
Apply the arpeggio-1-5-3-5 pattern on top once chord changes are smooth
Work through the Foundation songs in this family, one at a time, using the 20-minute learning method from the Technique Library

title: vi-IV-I-V and I-vi-IV-V (23 songs unlocked)
focus: Same chords as week 3, different order/starting point — notice how much of this transfers.
goals: Compare vi-IV-I-V and I-vi-IV-V against week 3's progression — same 4 chords, different feel
Introduce the alberti-bass pattern as an alternative texture
Work through this week's Foundation songs

title: Thai ballad walk-down + slash chords (10 songs unlocked)
focus: The signature Thai-ballad sound. This is the highest-value week in the whole plan — likely unlocks your biggest single cluster of songs.
goals: Learn to read and play slash chords (C/E, G/B, etc.)
Drill the thai-ballad-rolling-arpeggio pattern with a walking bass
Work through this week's Foundation songs — expect this to take real repetition

title: Minor-centered ballads + waltz time (5 songs unlocked)
focus: Songs that open on the sad chord, plus anything in 3/4 time.
goals: Learn the waltz-oom-pah-pah pattern for any 3/4 songs
Practice progressions that center on vi instead of just passing through it
Work through this week's Foundation songs

title: Fluency + remaining Foundation songs
focus: Less new theory, more speed and confident sight-reading of charts you haven't memorized.
goals: Clear any remaining Foundation-tier songs using patterns you already know
Practice sight-reading a chord chart you've never seen while listening to the track
Start dipping into Stretch tier — same families, just new songs to apply them to

title: Polish + expand
focus: Get your favorites performance-ready, and set up a sustainable way to keep working through Stretch/Reference tier after these 2 months.
goals: Full run-throughs (start to finish, no stopping) of your top 3-5 favorite songs
Record yourself once — it's the fastest way to hear what needs work
Pick a standing weekly slot to keep adding songs from Stretch/Reference tier going forward
